def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

def binding(p):
    p = Path(p)
    b = p.read_bytes()
    return {'path': p.as_posix(), 'sha256': sha(b), 'bytes': len(b)}

def checked(f):
    b = Path(f['path']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(b) == f['sha256'], f['path']
    assert len(b) == f['bytes'], f['path']
    return b

def load(p):
    return json.loads(Path(p).read_bytes())

def pointer(d, p):
    if not p:
        return d
    assert p.startswith('/')
    for part in p[1:].split('/'):
        part = part.replace('~1', '/').replace('~0', '~')
        d = d[int(part)] if isinstance(d, list) else d[part]
    return d

def at(p, ptr):
    return pointer(load(p), ptr)

def git(*a):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(REPO), *a])

def raw_record(d):
    b = d['rawUtf8'].encode('utf-8')
    assert sha(b) == d['sha256'] and len(b) == d['bytes']
    return b
